meta.name: schema-markup-generator
meta.description: Generate JSON-LD structured data markup for rich results in Google Search. Supports FAQ, HowTo, Article, Product, LocalBusiness, and multi-type schemas. Validates against Google requirements and provides implementation guidance. Use when asked to "add schema markup", "generate structured data", "JSON-LD", "rich snippets", "FAQ schema", "product markup", "add structured data to my page", "how to get rich snippets", or any structured data task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为网页生成结构化数据标记，提升搜索引擎展示效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Google搜索中展示更丰富的页面信息
copy.tagline_en: Generate structured data markup for better search engine display
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to display richer page information in Google search results

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的内容生成 JSON-LD 格式的结构化数据标记，帮助网页在谷歌搜索中获得富媒体摘要。它支持常见类型如 FAQ、产品、文章等，并验证标记是否符合谷歌要求。
howto.when: 当你要求“添加结构化数据”、“生成 JSON-LD”、“FAQ 标记”、“产品标记”或任何与结构化数据相关的任务时触发。

say.text: 为这个 FAQ 页面生成结构化数据标记。
为我的产品页面创建 Product 标记。
检查并改进这段现有的结构化数据。
say.note: Claude 会验证并优化你提供的 JSON-LD。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can generate JSON-LD structured data markup based on your content to help web pages get rich results in Google Search. It supports common types like FAQ, Product, Article, etc., and validates the markup against Google requirements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "add structured data", "generate JSON-LD", "FAQ markup", "product markup", or any structured data related task.

say_en.text: Generate structured data markup for this FAQ page.
Create Product markup for my product page.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Product markup with price, availability, etc.

say_en.text: Review and improve this existing structured data.
say_en.note: Claude will validate and optimize your provided JSON-LD.
